messages:
maria: Heads up — we're onboarding a small GPU customer fleet in eu-west-3 next week and need to lock down public IP allocations and ENI quotas before the canary. Can we get quota increases and a short plan for stable IP assignment?

maria: TL;DR: ~120 public IPs reserved across 3 accounts (prod/staging/dev), ENI-per-subnet limits bumped, and an IPv6 prefix for long-lived services. Need this by Thu (5 days).

lee: Quick q — why EIPs instead of NAT egress for most of the fleet? NAT scales cheaper.

maria: Good call. Most worker nodes can egress over NAT for model downloads, but some nodes host model-serving ELBs and need stable public endpoints (customer traffic for canary). Also debug/ssh access for a tiny subset. Hence mix of EIPs + NAT.

devon: For p4d/p5-like instances we also need to ensure ENI attachment limits in the account/subnet are ok. Some instance types support multiple ENIs and we create a secondary ENI for management traffic. What instance types + AZ counts are we planning?

maria: Plan: 10 canary GPUs in eu-west-3a, 10 in 3b, 10 in 3c (30 total per account) x 3 accounts = 90 active EIPs, plus 10 buffer = 100. Asking for 120 to be safe. Instance type is g5 or similar (1 ENI + 1 mgmt ENI per node).

ashley: I can open the ASG quota/ENI/EIP cases with cloud support. Need exact account IDs and preferred target quotas. Also we should request an IPv6 prefix (/56) on the VPC for long-lived endpoints.

maria: Account IDs: prod-gpu: 111111111111, staging-gpu: 222222222222, dev-gpu: 333333333333. Request targets: EIP limit = 120 per account, Elastic IPs in VPC (nonstandard) enabled, ENI allocation per subnet bump to handle 40 nodes per AZ, and request /56 IPv6 delegation for each VPC.

ashley: Copy. I'll open three cases:
- Case A: Increase Elastic IP quota to 120 (reason: stable public endpoints for GPU canaries)
- Case B: Increase ENI allocation + private IP per ENI in target subnets
- Case C: Request IPv6 /56 for VPCs + enable IPv6 auto-assign on subnets
I'll include the canary timeline and contact info.

lee: Please also add a request to whitelist our secondary-account for bursting public IPs — the account-level soft limits sometimes block automation.

ashley: Noted. I'll ask support to flag the automation/bulk allocation pattern and to expedite.

devon: Ops note: Let's ensure we create an IPAM scope and pre-assign EIP pools per AZ to avoid AZ imbalance during scale-up. If we rely on random EIPs, we might fail to attach in one AZ when that AZ's pool is exhausted.

maria: Agreed. We'll do AZ-affinity. I'll add a step in the onboarding playbook: pre-allocate EIPs to eu-west-3a/b/c and tag them with "gpu-canary" and account.

ashley: Cases opened (draft snippets):
```
Service: VPC (Elastic IPs)
Account: 111111111111
Request: Increase VPC Elastic IP quota from 50 -> 120
Reason: Onboarding GPU canary fleet requiring stable public endpoints across 3 AZs. Planned launch date: 5 days from request.
```

ashley: I'll mirror those for the other accounts and include the ENI limits. Expected response time 24-72h but asked for expedited review.

lee: Cost check — EIPs attached to stopped instances still incur charges; we'll ensure automation detaches/recycles EIPs when nodes are drained. Also run a quick calc for NAT gateway vs EIP per node monthly cost.

maria: Noted. We'll only attach EIPs to LB/edge nodes, and keep worker nodes behind NAT. I'll add a CI test to fail if any non-edge node has an EIP after deployment.

devon: One more: request increases for secondary private IPs per ENI in the subnet (we attach IPs for sidecars/monitoring). Include that in the case text.

ashley: Done. Cases submitted for all 3 accounts. Case numbers: TBD (support portal will assign). I'll post updates here when we get a response.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment scheduled for 2040054400 — will pause if any quota case not closed by 2040054300.

maria: Thanks everyone. If support asks for a diagram or expected allocation table, I'll paste it here. For now, monitoring playbook: Tag EIPs with: team=eng-infra, purpose=gpu-canary, az=eu-west-3a|b|c.

lee: Thanks — ping me when cases are back. I'll prepare the NAT fallback plan just in case. :thumbsup:

ashley: Update 2h: Support opened cases and requested additional justification for IPv6. Provided expected endpoints and traffic profile. Will escalate if no reply in 24h.

maria: Appreciate it.
